intro.text: EON Resources, Inc. (the “Company” or “EON”), was incorporated in Delaware as a blank check company formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. Prior to closing the Purchase, our efforts were limited to organizational activities, completion of an initial public offering and the evaluation of possible business combinations. On February 15, 2022, we consummated the Initial Public Offering of 7,500,000 units (the “Units”), at $10.00 per Unit, generating proceeds of $75,000,000. Additionally, the underwriter fully exercised its option to purchase 1,125,000 additional Units, for which we received cash proceeds of $11,250,000.

costs.heading: Lease Operating Expenses
costs.text: Lease operating expenses were $10,274,781 for the year ended December 31, 2025, compared to $8,614,080 for the year ended December 31, 2024. On a per unit basis, production expenses increased 30% from $29.59 per BOE for the year ended December 31, 2024, to $38.33 per BOE for the year ended December 31, 2025.

ga.heading: General and Administrative
ga.text: General and administrative expenses were $12,080,450 as of December 31, 2025, compared to $10,381,095 as of December 31, 2024. The increase in general and administrative expenses is primarily due to increased legal and professional fees associated with the transactions closed during the current period, partially offset by decreased stock-based compensation in the current period of $1,067,140 compared to $2,778,991 in the comparative period.

nonop.text: Interest expense was $4,892,170 for the year ended of December 31, 2025, compared to $7,643,200 for the year ended December 31, 2024. The decrease in interest expense is driven by the decreases in the Private Notes Payable and the Senior Secured Term Loan, along with the eventual settlement of the Senior Term Loan.

ocf.heading: Operating Activities
ocf.text: The change in net cash flow used in operating activities for the year ended December 31, 2025, as compared to 2024 is primarily due to decreased production volumes and market prices for crude oil.

da.heading: Depletion, Depreciation and Amortization
da.text: Depletion, depreciation and amortization (“DD&A”) was $6,710,092 as of December 31, 2025, compared to $2,407,098 as of December 31, 2024. DD&A was $25.03 per BOE for the year ended December 31, 2025, compared to $8.27 per BOE for the year ended December 31, 2024. The aggregate increase in DD&A expense for the year ended December 31, 2025 compared to 2024 was driven by a 203% increase in the DD&A rate per BOE, partially offset by a 8% decrease in production levels. The increase in the DD&A rate per BOE was driven by the increase in the oil and gas properties balance due to the development of the Seven Rivers waterflood interval and the decrease in the reserves balance due to the net conveyance of the additional 5% overriding royalty interest to Virtus, along with a change in reserve classification from proved to probable.

net sales.heading: Other Revenue
net sales.text: Other revenue was $383,196 for the year ended December 31, 2025 compared to $487,109 for year ended December 31, 2024. The revenue is related to providing water services to a third party. The contract is for one year starting on September 1, 2022, and has been renewed by mutual agreement.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Wages, services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
